name: Kagayaki Mizuno
source:
Mizuno is from a famous clan and a respected family.
After the scandal, people around him began to look at him askance, but Mizuno soon came to terms with it.
He also developed a bad habit: being rude to someone for no reason.
Currently, he works as Tin-Qin's assistant.
When they first met, she irritated him, but over time, after getting to know her better, Mizuno began to respect her.
